messages:
sre-bot: ALERT: High fncall exec rate detected on api-prod-us-east-1 (p95 exec latency stable) - auto-rate-limit triggered at 3690002440
alice (oncall): I'm paged, grabbing it. seeing 4x normal invoke rate on /v1/invoke-tool
mike (eng-runtime): looking at Router metrics, spike appears from a single caller org: org-free-7f
jordan (sre): partitioning to workers is fine, errors are 503s downstream from tool-proxy timeouts
alice (oncall): immediate mitigation: can we throttle tool-invoke for free tier only? prefer soft 20rps cap + slow-start
mike (eng-runtime): yes. pushing policy: 
```
route: /v1/invoke-tool
match: org.plan == "free"
action: rate_limit(20rps, burst=40)
```
should deploy in ~30s
ops-bot: deploy accepted by canary pipeline, commit 8f3a2b -> canary
sam (support): flagging top impacted customers: cust-neo, cust-arc, cust-lumen. opening support notif drafts
alice (oncall): also we should temporarily disable structured_output for non-enterprise plans (text-only fallback). will flip config key `structured_output.enabled=false` for org.plan != "enterprise"
mike (eng-runtime): applied config change to edge-config v23, propagation ~45s. KV cache unaffected
jordan (sre): monitoring for increased LM token usage after fallback — keep an eye on cost curve
alice (oncall): FYI: customer impact: degraded tool responses (no tool results) for free tier, some jobs may see 1-2 minute delays. Enterprise unaffected
sam (support): sending support banner: "We're mitigating a high-volume tool-invoke issue; free-tier tool results may be delayed or unavailable. ETA 15-30m." Will post to status page once confirmed
mike (eng-runtime): can we enable bounceback: when tool-invoke rejected return 200 with `{"text":"tool temporarily disabled; try text-only"}` to reduce retries
alice (oncall): good idea, implement soft-deny for clients to avoid retries
ops-bot: rollout complete: rate-limit policy active on 100% of edge-canaries
jordan (sre): metrics: fncall QPS from org-free-7f down 85% after policy, errors reduced. latency p95 improved
alice (oncall): moving to incident bridge for postmortem + timeline. handoff to jordan for monitoring and mike for followup config cleanup
jordan (sre): taking ownership for monitoring; will keep incident open for 2h then escalate
sam (support): posting status update now. will coordinate individual customer notifications
alice (oncall): closing pager for now; if anything regresses ping pager again :thumbsup:
